category: Bhaashaabhedam (register: Sanskritic and native, familiar and respectful)
label: the Sanskrit-tatsama greeting against the everyday one
note: MEASURED FROM THIS TRACK, NOT BORROWED FROM TAMIL. Four lessons in this corpus carry register: formal, and every one of them is a Sanskrit-tatsama time-of-day greeting; namaskaram is respectful-neutral and works at any hour. That is a lexical register split between borrowed and inherited words -- it is NOT Tamil's literary/spoken diglossia, and this file does not claim one.
